summary: The real cookie-assertion engine ported from expect-cookies (Gregory Langlais, MIT, npm 'expect-cookies'). Parses Set-Cookie/Cookie headers and builds a chainable set of assertion verbs (.set, .reset, .new, .renew, .contain, .not) that check a response's cookies against expectations, including signed-cookie verification via cookie-signature.
